# MyTuums Cloudflare proof of concept

This synthetic-data environment is protected by owner-only Cloudflare Access.
It is not a public version of MyTuums and must not be indexed.

- Application: https://cf-poc.mytuums.com
- Branding: https://about-cf-poc.mytuums.com

Application authentication remains inside Access. A signed-out application user
may view the auth/legal pages and eligible individual posts only after Access
admission; feeds and account features still require an application session.
